steps.name: Install Open XML SDK validator runtime
Configure private dependency access
steps.run:
if [ -n "$OOXML_STACK_TOKEN" ]; then
  git config --local --unset-all http.https://github.com/.extraheader || :
  git config --global --unset-all http.https://github.com/.extraheader || :
  AUTH_HEADER="$(printf 'x-access-token:%s' "$OOXML_STACK_TOKEN" | base64 | tr -d '\n')"
  git config --global http.https://github.com/.extraheader "AUTHORIZATION: basic $AUTH_HEADER"
else
  mkdir -p ~/.ssh
  printf '%s\n' "$OOXML_SPEC_DEPLOY_KEY" > ~/.ssh/ooxml_spec
  printf '%s\n' "$OOXML_TEST_FRAMEWORK_DEPLOY_KEY" > ~/.ssh/ooxml_test_framework
  printf '%s\n' "$PYTHON_PPTX_DEPLOY_KEY" > ~/.ssh/python_pptx
  printf '%s\n' "$PYTHON_DOCX_DEPLOY_KEY" > ~/.ssh/python_docx
  chmod 600 ~/.ssh/ooxml_spec ~/.ssh/ooxml_test_framework ~/.ssh/python_pptx ~/.ssh/python_docx
  ssh-keyscan github.com >> ~/.ssh/known_hosts
  cat >> ~/.ssh/config <<'EOF'
Host github-ooxml-spec
  HostName github.com
  User git
  IdentityFile ~/.ssh/ooxml_spec
  IdentitiesOnly yes

Host github-ooxml-test-framework
  HostName github.com
  User git
  IdentityFile ~/.ssh/ooxml_test_framework
  IdentitiesOnly yes

Host github-python-pptx
  HostName github.com
  User git
  IdentityFile ~/.ssh/python_pptx
  IdentitiesOnly yes

Host github-python-docx
  HostName github.com
  User git
  IdentityFile ~/.ssh/python_docx
  IdentitiesOnly yes
EOF
  git config --global url."ssh://git@github-ooxml-spec/ooxml-stack/ooxml-spec".insteadOf "https://github.com/ooxml-stack/ooxml-spec"
  git config --global url."ssh://git@github-ooxml-test-framework/ooxml-stack/ooxml-test-framework".insteadOf "https://github.com/ooxml-stack/ooxml-test-framework"
  git config --global url."ssh://git@github-python-pptx/ooxml-stack/python-pptx".insteadOf "https://github.com/ooxml-stack/python-pptx"
  git config --global url."ssh://git@github-python-docx/ooxml-stack/python-docx".insteadOf "https://github.com/ooxml-stack/python-docx"
fi

steps.name: Checkout public claim evidence repos
steps.run:
clone_evidence_repos() {
  rm -rf ../ooxml-stack ../python-pptx ../python-docx
  git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/ooxml-stack/ooxml-stack.git ../ooxml-stack
  git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/ooxml-stack/python-pptx.git ../python-pptx
  git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/ooxml-stack/python-docx.git ../python-docx
}
for attempt in 1 2 3; do
  clone_evidence_repos && break
  if [ "$attempt" = 3 ]; then exit 1; fi
  sleep $((attempt * 5))
done

steps.name: Run coverage gate
steps.run:
uv run --frozen --with coverage coverage run --source=src/ooxml_core -m pytest -q
uv run --frozen --with coverage coverage report

steps.name: Run the shared local and server gate
steps.run: make check CHECK_COMMIT="${{ github.sha }}" CHECK_OUTPUT="${{ runner.temp }}/ci-reports"

steps.name: Record the default partition receipt
steps.run:
report=$(find "${{ runner.temp }}/ci-reports" -name pytest.json | head -1)
python3 -m scripts.ci.platform_summary write \
  --report "$report" --commit "${{ github.sha }}" --bucket default \
  --platform linux --runner ubuntu-24.04 \
  --output "${{ runner.temp }}/platform-receipt-default.json"

steps.name: Record hosted failure diagnostics
steps.run:
mapfile -t reports < <(find "${{ runner.temp }}/ci-reports" -name report.json)
args=(--root . --output "${{ runner.temp }}/hosted-diagnostics.json")
if [ "${#reports[@]}" -eq 1 ]; then
  run_dir=$(dirname "${reports[0]}")
  args+=(--report "${reports[0]}" --pytest-report "$run_dir/pytest.json" --events "$run_dir/pytest-events.jsonl" --collected "$run_dir/pytest-collected.json" --attempt "$run_dir/pytest-attempt.json")
else
  args+=(--reports "${{ runner.temp }}/ci-reports")
fi
python3 -m scripts.ci.hosted_diagnostics "${args[@]}"

steps.name: Configure private dependency access
steps.run:
if [ -n "$OOXML_STACK_TOKEN" ]; then
  git config --local --unset-all http.https://github.com/.extraheader || :
  git config --global --unset-all http.https://github.com/.extraheader || :
  AUTH_HEADER="$(printf 'x-access-token:%s' "$OOXML_STACK_TOKEN" | base64 | tr -d '\n')"
  git config --global http.https://github.com/.extraheader "AUTHORIZATION: basic $AUTH_HEADER"
else
  if [ -z "$OOXML_CORE_DEPLOY_KEY" ] || [ -z "$OOXML_SPEC_DEPLOY_KEY" ]; then
    echo "OOXML_STACK_TOKEN or both OOXML_CORE_DEPLOY_KEY and OOXML_SPEC_DEPLOY_KEY are required"
    exit 1
  fi
  mkdir -p ~/.ssh
  printf '%s\n' "$OOXML_CORE_DEPLOY_KEY" > ~/.ssh/ooxml_core
  printf '%s\n' "$OOXML_SPEC_DEPLOY_KEY" > ~/.ssh/ooxml_spec
  chmod 600 ~/.ssh/ooxml_core ~/.ssh/ooxml_spec
  ssh-keyscan github.com >> ~/.ssh/known_hosts
  cat >> ~/.ssh/config <<'EOF'
Host github-ooxml-core
  HostName github.com
  User git
  IdentityFile ~/.ssh/ooxml_core
  IdentitiesOnly yes

Host github-ooxml-spec
  HostName github.com
  User git
  IdentityFile ~/.ssh/ooxml_spec
  IdentitiesOnly yes
EOF
  git config --global url."ssh://git@github-ooxml-core/ooxml-stack/ooxml-core".insteadOf "https://github.com/ooxml-stack/ooxml-core"
  git config --global url."ssh://git@github-ooxml-core/ooxml-stack/ooxml-core.git".insteadOf "https://github.com/ooxml-stack/ooxml-core.git"
  git config --global url."ssh://git@github-ooxml-spec/ooxml-stack/ooxml-spec".insteadOf "https://github.com/ooxml-stack/ooxml-spec"
  git config --global url."ssh://git@github-ooxml-spec/ooxml-stack/ooxml-spec.git".insteadOf "https://github.com/ooxml-stack/ooxml-spec.git"
fi
git ls-remote https://github.com/ooxml-stack/ooxml-core.git HEAD >/dev/null
git ls-remote https://github.com/ooxml-stack/ooxml-spec.git HEAD >/dev/null
